family_spec.purpose: Rank moderate orderly pullbacks within a positive 20-session trend by path efficiency and recent volume contraction.
family_spec.universe: All preserved daily source symbol/session rows with valid signal-day OHLCV and finite required signal-time features; no watchlist cap, no one-name-per-day cap, no arbitrary liquidity or market-regime gate.
family_spec.candidate_pool: ret20 > 0 and ret5 < 0, with finite 20-session path efficiency and volume_trend5_20.

features.ret5: Signal close / close 5 XTKS sessions earlier - 1.
features.ret20: Signal close / close 20 XTKS sessions earlier - 1.
features.path_efficiency20: ret20 divided by the sum of absolute close-to-close returns over the same 20 XTKS sessions; all 20 returns must be observed, with no forward fill.
features.volume_trend5_20: Mean volume over the five sessions immediately before signal date divided by mean volume over the 20 sessions immediately before signal date; signal-day volume excluded.

ranking.score: Arithmetic mean of the within-date average percentile rank of path_efficiency20 (higher is better) and volume_trend5_20 (lower is better).

family_spec.target: Gross return from next XTKS session open to close of the fifth XTKS session including entry; unresolved/actionability failures remain in the requested cohort.

selection.cooldown: One immediately prior XTKS session per independent Top-N policy; only actually selected symbols update that policy state; state carries across year boundaries.

periods.discovery: 2022-07-01 through the final XTKS session of 2023; candidates whose fifth-session exit is beyond the final 2023 session are purged.
periods.confirmation: 2024 is opened only after discovery pool KEEP and one unchanged Top-N policy passes all frozen gates; historical and retrospective, never true OOS.
periods.2025: Locked replay only after unchanged 2024 confirmation passes.
periods.2026: Report only; no fitting, feature, candidate, rank, or policy selection from 2026 outcomes.

family_spec.family_gate: At assumed 0.5% round-trip cost, candidate-pool signal mean, median, and top-three-winner-excluded mean must be positive; complete daily cohort mean, median, and top-three-winner-excluded mean must also be positive. Insufficient complete-cohort coverage is INCONCLUSIVE; unresolved rows are not dropped.
family_spec.selection_policy_gate: Apply the registered batch01 Core gates unchanged: positive net signal/cohort mean, median and top-three-winner-excluded means; at least 20 common complete active dates and positive paired pool-relative cohort value add; selected -10%/-20% rates no worse than the full pool. If the pool has no complete cohorts, value-add is not established and no N can pass.
family_spec.data_quality: Yahoo-derived current-universe daily history is not proven point-in-time membership, full delisted coverage, corporate-action adjusted, or executable at next open. All historical results are RETROSPECTIVE_PROVISIONAL.
family_spec.no_tuning: No threshold, feature weight, candidate rule, missingness rule, target, or Top-N changes after any discovery outcomes are opened.
family_spec.production_boundary: Research only. Any future scorer must run entirely in the ordinary production runtime without Codex, LLM, or external model calls. No production wiring is part of this experiment.
